more: Client texts carry the business name, the date, the time, the place and a link. Never the kind of visit or any health detail.

branch.label: Signs of an eating disorder
branch.endText: No booking by the AI. The person has the business's own line, a doctor, and 911 and 988.

steps.title: Gives the business's own line for this care
steps.does: The words sound like an eating disorder. The AI books nothing. Lee Home Nutrition's own team books this care by phone, with the person's doctor.
more: Signs like making yourself throw up, using laxatives to get rid of food, or going days without eating.
No weight-loss or meal-plan visit is offered.
Rosie never names a condition, and gives no advice about food or weight.
On a call, Rosie says the same words out loud.
If the person is already a client, their dietitian and Sam are told the same day, with a link, never the words.

say.text: {{biz.name}}'s own team books this kind of care by phone, together with your doctor: {{biz.phone}}. Please also talk with your doctor soon. If you feel faint or unwell now, call 911. If you have thoughts of hurting yourself, call or text 988.
say.plainText: {{biz.name}}'s own team books this kind of care by phone, together with your doctor: {{biz.phone}}. Please also talk with your doctor soon. If you feel faint or unwell now, call 911. If you have thoughts of hurting yourself, call or text 988.

steps.rule: Rosie's rule: signs of an eating disorder go to the business's own team and a doctor, never to an automatic booking. Why: a weight or meal-plan visit booked by an AI could harm someone who has one.
